content: Do not mourn for what has vanished into the past, nor boast of what you have gathered today.
author: Sanskrit Subhashitas
explanation: Mourning the past is digging up old bones; boasting of the present is painting targets on your back. The noble human rests in serene presence, thankful for the bread of today, respectful of the lessons of yesterday, and peaceful before tomorrow.
practicalInsight: Let go of one nostalgic regret and one boastful impulse today. Savor the quiet dignity of the eternal present.
reflectionPrompt: Are you living in the graveyard of the past or the circus of future bragging, missing the sacred reality of now?
